story.originalTitle: How Cadillac is ‘building its plane while flying in it’ in F1
story.summaryEn: Cadillac Formula 1 team principal Graeme Lowdon has given an update on the outfit's current infrastructure, which is still being developed. Lowdon described the process as "building the plane while flying in it."
detailZh: 凯迪拉克如何在F1中“边飞边造飞机”
车队位于美国的新基地仍在印第安纳州建设中
凯迪拉克F1车队负责人格雷姆·洛登在发车格上注视前方。
凯迪拉克F1车队负责人格雷姆·洛登介绍了车队当前仍在建设中的基础设施情况。
这支F1最新加入的车队运营于多个地点，主要是其银石基地，同时充分利用通用汽车在北卡罗来纳州和密歇根州的设施，并使用丰田在科隆的风洞。
凯迪拉克一直在印第安纳波利斯郊区的费舍尔斯建设新的F1工厂，而其动力单元部门将设在夏洛特地区，母公司已在该地区设有基地。
与此同时，车队仍在追逐首次进入Q2和首个世界锦标赛积分。
“我们仍在建设，”洛登说。“这就像边飞边造飞机，或者边航行边造船。我们仍在做这些。我们仍在建设工厂。”
“我办公桌旁边放着一些钢头靴和安全帽，我们会去查看建筑工地。一个在印第安纳波利斯非常非常大的工地，然后还有一个在银石较小的工地。显然，动力单元公司也在夏洛特建设工厂。”
凯迪拉克F1车队银石车间
“我们还在疯狂招聘，所以仍有大量建设工作在进行。然后今年Q2让我们开始了解MAC-26的优缺点，以及车队运营上的优缺点。”
“我们喜欢说每天都是上学日。如果哪一天我们没有学到东西，那就是浪费了一天。所以我们只是试图找到每一个可以改进的领域，并不断、不断地改进。”
“目前，改进的幅度很大，因为要做的事情太多，新东西也太多。所以我们还远未到那种只是微调事情的阶段，我认为很多其他车队可能更处于那种模式。”
就费舍尔斯工厂而言，洛登暗示“很快会有更多关于各种设施何时投入使用的公告”，新模拟器“正在安装中”。
“目前仍在建设中，”这位英国人解释道。“这将分阶段进行，因为面积有45万平方英尺。这可不小。”
当被问及费舍尔斯工厂是否会在明年开始运作时，洛登回答说：“大体而言，是的。那里的整个建设已经非常先进，但这是一个巨大的项目。”
“有很多事情正在发生，银石也有许多设施即将投入使用。”
detailEn: How Cadillac is ‘building its plane while flying in it’ in F1
The team’s new American base is still taking shape in Indiana
Graeme Lowdon, Team Principal, Cadillac F1 Team, looks on from the grid.
Cadillac Formula 1 team principal Graeme Lowdon has given an update on the outfit’s current infrastructure, which is still being developed.

F1’s newest squad operates from several locations, mainly its Silverstone hub, while it makes the most of General Motors facilities in North Carolina and Michigan, and uses Toyota’s wind tunnel in Cologne.
Cadillac has been building a new F1 factory in Fishers, in the Indianapolis suburbs, while its power unit department will be based in the Charlotte area where the parent company is already based.
Meanwhile, the team keeps chasing its first Q2 appearance and maiden world championship points.
“We're still building,” Lowdon said. “It's building the plane while flying in it, or the ship while we're sailing in it. We are still doing that. We're still building factories.

“Next to my desk are some steel toecap boots and a hard hat, and we go and look at construction sites. A very, very big one in Indianapolis, and then a smaller one in Silverstone. And obviously the PU company is building the factory down in Charlotte as well.
Cadillac F1 Team works shop in Silverstone

“We're still recruiting like mad as well, and so there's still an awful lot of building going on. And then Q2 of this year has kind of allowed us to start understanding the strengths and weaknesses of the MAC-26 as well, and also the strengths and weaknesses of the team operationally.

“We like to say every day is a school day. If it's a day where we haven't learned something, it's a day we've wasted. And so we're just trying to find every area that we can improve and constantly, constantly improve.

“And at the minute, it's big chunks because there's just so much to do and there's so much that's new as well. And so we're somewhere off that area where you're just refining things, where I think a lot of the other teams are probably more in that mode.”
As far as the Fishers factory is concerned, Lowdon hinted at “more announcements soon about when various things will come online”, with the new simulator “going in as we speak”.
“It's still in construction at the moment,” the Briton explained. “It'll be phased, because it's 450,000 square feet. It's not small.”
Asked if things would start next year at Fishers, Lowdon replied: “In broad terms, yes. It's very well advanced, the whole construction there, but it's a huge project.
“There's a lot happening and coming online at Silverstone as well.”
keyPointsZh: 车队主要基地在银石，同时利用通用汽车在北卡罗来纳州和密歇根州的设施，并使用丰田在科隆的风洞。
车队正在印第安纳波利斯郊区的费舍尔斯建设新F1工厂，动力单元部门将设在夏洛特地区。
洛登表示新模拟器“正在安装中”，费舍尔斯工厂建设分阶段进行，总面积45万平方英尺。
keyPointsEn: The team's main hub is in Silverstone, while it utilizes General Motors facilities in North Carolina and Michigan, and uses Toyota's wind tunnel in Cologne.
The team is building a new F1 factory in Fishers, in the Indianapolis suburbs, while its power unit department will be based in the Charlotte area.
Lowdon said the new simulator is "going in as we speak," and the Fishers factory construction is phased, totaling 450,000 square feet.

relatedItems.originalTitle: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
detailZh: F1美国大奖赛：汉密尔顿在FP3中险胜维斯塔潘
法拉利在COTA的每节练习中都排名第一，进入排位赛
汉密尔顿在F1美国大奖赛的最后一节练习中排名第一，领先维斯塔潘和勒克莱尔进入奥斯汀的排位赛
在第三节的最后20分钟里，汉密尔顿是唯一打破1分35秒大关的车手，频繁的越界行为使得法拉利队友勒克莱尔无法超越他登上排行榜。
本节练习的前三圈只能用平淡无奇来形容，但随着汉密尔顿在软胎上跑出1分36.716秒，超越了多个使用中等轮胎的圈速。
不久后，小红牛车队和迈凯轮的利亚姆·劳森打破了汉密尔顿的成绩，而几位重量级选手仍在使用中等轮胎进行圈速测试。
尽管范斯特appen对换挡时的不稳定状态有所抱怨，但他凭借黄色侧壁轮胎的1分35.702秒成绩名列前茅。
汉密尔顿迅速提升了成绩，使用软胎跑出了1分35.561秒。但勒克莱尔尽管使用的是较慢的中胎，却以1分35.127秒的成绩接管了领先位置，这表明还有更多的速度可以挖掘。
进入最后20分钟，安东内利在软胎上比勒克莱尔快了十分之一，但他在9号弯道超出了赛道限制，导致这一圈被取消。
维斯塔潘遵守了白线，以1分35.061秒的成绩排名第一，红牛车队在第一区段是最快的，但汉密尔顿的成绩低于1分35秒，达到了1分34.893秒。
在整个练习过程中一直出现的赛道限制问题，也阻止了勒克莱尔重新夺回第一的位置，因为他在10号弯道越过了白线。
这意味着摩纳哥车手只能满足于排在汉密尔顿和维斯塔潘之后，为周六下午的排位赛设置了一场紧张激烈的局面。
冠军车手安东内利排在第四位，领先于梅赛德斯车队的队友乔治·拉塞尔，银箭车队似乎在纯速度上落后半步，皮亚斯蒂在难以驾驭的MCL40中排在第六位。
在奥迪车队，尼科·胡肯伯格阻止了麦克拉伦车队的兰多·诺里斯获得第七名，世界冠军的1分35.2秒成绩也因为第十弯的赛道限制而被取消。
阿尔派车队的皮埃尔·加斯利排在第九位，落后汉密尔顿一秒，伊萨克·哈德贾在第二辆小红牛车队中排在第十位，这位法国车手因为他的赛车操控问题而感到沮丧。
detailEn: F1 United States GP: Lewis Hamilton pips Max Verstappen in FP3
Ferrari heads into qualifying having topped every practice session at COTA
Lewis Hamilton finished final practice on top at Formula 1's United States Grand Prix, leading Max Verstappen and Charles Leclerc into qualifying at Austin.

Hamilton was the only driver to break the 1m35s barrier in the final 20 minutes of third practice, as frequent track limits transgressions kept Ferrari team-mate Leclerc from leapfrogging him on the leaderboard.
Following an opening quarter of the session which can only be described as pedestrian, action picked up as Hamilton set a 1m36.716s on softs to get ahead of a number of medium-tyred install laps.
His time was soon beaten by Liam Lawson in the Racing Bulls and McLaren's Oscar Piastri, while several heavy hitters kept turning laps on medium tyres instead.
Verstappen even went top courtesy of a 1m35.702s on the yellow sidewall tyre, despite recurring complaints about his unsettling downshifts.

Hamilton swiftly improved upon the Dutchman's lap, using softs to set a 1m35.561s. But when Leclerc took over command with a 1m35.127s despite using the slower mediums, that underlined there was still a lot more pace to find.
Entering the final 20 minutes, Antonelli took a tenth out of Leclerc's time on softs, but his lap was scratched for breaking track limits at Turn 9.
Verstappen did adhere to the white lines to set a 1m35.061s and go top, with Red Bull the quickest car through sector one, only for Hamilton to dip below the 1m35s barrier with a 1m34.893s.
Track limits, which have been a recurring theme throughout practice, also kept Leclerc from reclaiming first as he dipped over the white line at Turn 10.
That meant the Monegasque had to settle for third behind Hamilton and Verstappen, setting up a finely poised qualifying session on Saturday afternoon.

Championship leader Antonelli was fourth ahead of Mercedes team-mate George Russell, as the Silver Arrows appears to be a half-step behind on pure pace, with Piastri sixth in the difficult to tame MCL40.
In the Audi, Nico Hulkenberg kept McLaren’s Lando Norris from seventh, with the world champion’s 1m35.2s also deleted for track limits at Turn 10.
Alpine driver Pierre Gasly was ninth, a full second behind Hamilton, with Isack Hadjar 10th in the second Red Bull as the Frenchman was left frustrated by his car's handling.
keyPointsZh: 勒克莱尔因越界无法超越汉密尔顿
keyPointsEn: Leclerc could not overtake Hamilton due to track limits transgressions
